methods.name: _engine
methods.summary: Whether Docker can be reached. A Docker that cannot be reached is an answer (`reachable` is false and says why), not an error.

methods.name: _connect
methods.summary: Choose the Docker the chats' containers run in, and answer whether it can be reached. The containers of the Docker chosen before are not touched: a chat whose container is not in the new one gets a new container on its next turn.

params.name: host
params.description: Where Docker listens: `unix:///path/docker.sock`, `tcp://host:2375` or `http://host:2375`. Empty for this machine's own Docker.

errors.message: The address is not one Docker can be reached at.

methods.name: _copilots
methods.summary: The copilots a chat can be started with, by name.

methods.name: _add_copilot
methods.summary: Add a copilot. Its image is built when it is asked for (`_build`) or when a chat with it first needs its container.

params.name: name
params.description: What the copilot is called. Blank is refused with a message.

params.name: dockerfile
params.description: The Dockerfile its image is built from: the agent and the tools it works with. It is the whole build context, so it can copy nothing in: what it needs it downloads. Blank is refused with a message.

params.name: command
params.description: The agent's command: the program, then its arguments (`["claude-code-acp"]`). It is the container's command, and speaks the Agent Client Protocol on the container's standard input and output. A first item that is blank is refused with a message.

params.name: workdir
params.description: The folder the agent works in, in the container: each chat's own volume is mounted there, and the agent's sessions start there. An absolute path. Blank or absent: `/workspace`.

params.name: skills_dir
params.description: The folder its skills are copied into, in the container, each skill a folder of its own named after it. An absolute path. Blank or absent: `/root/.claude/skills`.

params.name: env
params.description: The container's environment variables, each with its value written out or taken from a keychain item. Absent: none.

params.name: mcp
params.description: The MCP servers its sessions are given. Absent: none.

params.name: skills
params.description: The ids of the skills of `_skills` it uses. Absent: none.

errors.message: The name, the Dockerfile or the command is blank, a folder is not an absolute path, a variable or an MCP server is not one (a name that cannot be one, two of the same name, a value and a keychain item both, a keychain item without its service or account, a stdio server without a command, an HTTP server without an http or https URL), or a skill is not in the library.

methods.name: _update_copilot
methods.summary: Change a copilot. A chat started before keeps the container it has: a change of the Dockerfile, the command, the folders, the environment or the skills reaches the chats started after it. The MCP servers reach every chat on its next connection.

params.name: copilot
params.description: The id of one of `_copilots`.

params.name: name
params.description: What the copilot is called. Blank is refused with a message.

params.name: dockerfile
params.description: The Dockerfile its image is built from, as `_add_copilot` takes it. A changed one is built when it is asked for (`_build`) or when a new chat first needs its container.

params.name: command
params.description: The agent's command: the program, then its arguments.

params.name: workdir
params.description: The folder the agent works in, in the container. Blank or absent: `/workspace`.

params.name: skills_dir
params.description: The folder its skills are copied into, in the container. Blank or absent: `/root/.claude/skills`.

params.name: env
params.description: The container's environment variables, in place of the ones it has. Absent: none.

params.name: mcp
params.description: The MCP servers its sessions are given, in place of the ones it has. Absent: none.

params.name: skills
params.description: The ids of the skills of `_skills` it uses, in place of the ones it has. Absent: none.

errors.message: There is no such copilot, or what is given is refused as `_add_copilot` refuses it.

methods.name: _remove_copilot
methods.summary: Remove a copilot, its chats with their containers and volumes, and its images. A turn it is taking ends.

params.name: copilot
params.description: The id of one of `_copilots`.

errors.message: There is no such copilot, its image is being built, or Docker did not remove a container, a volume or an image of it (Docker cannot be reached, say). What was removed before that stays removed.

methods.name: _build
methods.summary: Build a copilot's image from its Dockerfile as it is now. Answers at once: how the build goes follows as `building` events, and ends with one that says it is done or failed. A build of the copilot that is under way already goes on, and no second one starts.

params.name: copilot
params.description: The id of one of `_copilots`.

methods.name: _skills
methods.summary: The skills of the library, by name.

methods.name: _add_skill
methods.summary: Add a skill to the library.

params.name: name
params.description: What the skill is called: the name of its folder in the container. Letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-`, starting with a letter or a digit. Another skill's name is refused with a message.

params.name: text
params.description: Its `SKILL.md`. Blank is refused with a message.

params.name: files
params.description: Other files of the skill, each by its path in the skill's folder. Absent: none.

errors.message: The name cannot be a folder's or is another skill's, the SKILL.md is blank, or a file's path is not a relative path in the skill's folder (absolute, with `..`, `\` or an empty part, `SKILL.md` itself, or another file's).

methods.name: _update_skill
methods.summary: Change a skill. It reaches the containers made after it: a chat's container has the skills it was made with.

params.name: skill
params.description: The id of one of `_skills`.

params.name: name
params.description: What the skill is called, as `_add_skill` takes it.

params.name: text
params.description: Its `SKILL.md`. Blank is refused with a message.

params.name: files
params.description: Its other files, in place of the ones it has. Absent: none.

errors.message: There is no such skill, or what is given is refused as `_add_skill` refuses it.

methods.name: _remove_skill
methods.summary: Remove a skill from the library, and from the copilots that use it. The containers that have it keep it.

params.name: skill
params.description: The id of one of `_skills`.

methods.name: _secrets
methods.summary: The items of the keychain the Keychain app keeps, by service and account, for a variable or a header to take its value from. No password is given: it is read when a container is made or a session is given its MCP servers.

errors.message: The Keychain app is not there (not installed, or not running), or it did not list its items.

methods.name: _chats
methods.summary: Every chat, the most recently used first.

methods.name: _open
methods.summary: A chat and everything said and done in it so far.

methods.name: _send
methods.summary: Say something in a chat, or start one with a copilot by saying the first thing in it (`copilot` instead of `chat`): a chat is only made when something is said. Answers at once with the chat as it now stands; what the agent says and does follows as `item` and `piece` events and ends with a `turn` event. The chat's first turn makes its container (and builds the copilot's image when Docker does not have it yet), which takes a while.

params.name: chat
params.description: The chat to say it in. Without it, `copilot` starts a new chat.

params.name: copilot
params.description: The id of one of `_copilots`, to start a new chat with: used only without `chat`.

params.name: text
params.description: What to say. Blank is refused with a message.

errors.message: There is no such chat or copilot, the message is blank, or the agent is still answering.

methods.name: _answer
methods.summary: Answer a permission the agent asked for during its turn with one of the options it offered; its turn goes on.

params.name: item
params.description: The id of the `permission` item.

params.name: option
params.description: The `option_id` of one of the options in the item's data.

errors.message: There is no such chat or question, it is answered already, its turn is over, or the agent did not offer that option.

methods.name: _stop
methods.summary: Stop the agent's answer in a chat: the agent is asked to stop (its open questions are cancelled), and its turn ends when it has. What it said so far stays.

methods.name: _remove_chat
methods.summary: Delete a chat, everything in it, and its container and volume.

errors.message: Docker did not remove the chat's container or volume (Docker cannot be reached, say): the chat stays, and can be deleted again.

methods.name: _item
methods.summary: An item of a chat is new or changed during a turn: the whole item.

methods.name: _piece
methods.summary: Text is added to an item of a chat while it comes.

params.name: item
params.description: The id of the item.

params.name: text
params.description: The text added.

methods.name: _turn
methods.summary: The agent's turn in a chat is over, however it ended (complete, stopped or failed): read the chat again.

methods.name: _building
methods.summary: How the build of a copilot's image goes, a line at a time: Docker's output while it runs, then a last line that says it is done or why it failed. Read the copilots again once it is over.

params.name: copilot
params.description: The id of the copilot whose image is built.

params.name: line
params.description: A line of the build's output, or the last line: the image it made, or why it failed.

params.name: status
params.description: `running` while the build goes on, `done` when it made the image, `failed` when it did not.

version.description: Docker's version, empty when it cannot be reached.

host.description: Where Docker is looked for, as given to `_connect`. Empty for this machine's own Docker.

problem.description: Why Docker cannot be reached, as a sentence. Empty when it can.

Secret.description: An item of the keychain the Keychain app keeps: what its password is for and whose it is there.

Variable.description: A name and its value: an environment variable, or a header sent to an MCP server. The value is written out (`value`) or is the password of a keychain item (`secret`), read when it is needed and never kept by the app.

name.description: An environment variable's name: letters, digits and `_`, not starting with a digit. A header's: no spaces and no `:`.

value.description: The value, written out. Absent with `secret`; absent without it is empty.

secret.description: The keychain item whose password is the value.

Server.description: An MCP server a copilot's sessions are given. `stdio`: a program the agent starts in the container. `http`: a server at a URL, given only to an agent that takes MCP servers over HTTP.

url.description: `http`: its address, an `http` or `https` URL. In the container, this machine is `host.docker.internal`.

BuildStatus.description: How a build of an image goes: under way, done, or failed.

dockerfile.description: The Dockerfile its image is built from.

command.description: The agent's command: the program, then its arguments.

workdir.description: The folder the agent works in, in the container, where each chat's volume is mounted.

skills_dir.description: The folder its skills are copied into, in the container.

env.description: The container's environment variables. A keychain item is named, never its password.

mcp.description: The MCP servers its sessions are given.

skills.description: The ids of the skills it uses, in the order of their names.

image.description: The image its last build that succeeded made (`vos-copilot-<id>:<hash>`); empty before one has.

current.description: `image` was built from the Dockerfile as it is now.

problem.description: Why its last build failed, as a sentence; empty when it did not.

SkillFile.description: A file of a skill besides its SKILL.md.

path.description: Where it is in the skill's folder, with `/` between its parts (`scripts/check.sh`).

Skill.description: A skill of the library: a folder copied into each new container of a copilot that uses it.

name.description: What it is called, and the name of its folder.

title.description: The first thing said in it, shortened; `New chat` until then.

copilot.description: The name of the copilot it is with.

copilot_id.description: The id of the copilot it is with (one of `_copilots`).

updated.description: When it was last used, ISO 8601 in UTC.

Item.description: One thing said or done in a chat, in the order it happened.

kind.description: `user`: what the person said. `assistant`: what the agent said. `reasoning`: what it thought. `tool`: a tool call of its. `plan`: its plan for the turn. `permission`: a permission it asked for. `note`: something the person should know about the chat (the agent started a new session, it stopped short). `error`: a turn that failed.

text.description: `user`, `assistant`, `reasoning`, `note`, `error`: the text (`assistant` with a `name`: what the piece is, a link's name). `permission`: what the agent asks to do.

name.description: `tool`: the call's title. `assistant`: empty for text, else the kind of piece in `data`: `image`, `link` or `resource`.

data.description: JSON text, or empty. `assistant` with a `name`: the piece, `{ type: "image", mime_type, data }` (base64), `{ type: "link", uri, name }` or `{ type: "resource", uri, text }`. `tool`: `{ kind?, status?, content?, locations?, input?, output? }`: status `pending`, `in_progress`, `completed` or `failed`; content a list of pieces, `{ type: "text", text }`, an image, a link, a resource, `{ type: "diff", path, patch, new_file }` (`patch` a unified diff) or `{ type: "terminal", terminal_id }`; locations `{ path, line? }`; input and output JSON text. `plan`: `{ entries: [{ content, priority, status }] }` (priority `high`, `medium` or `low`; status `pending`, `in_progress` or `completed`). `permission`: `{ kind?, options: [{ option_id, name, kind }], chosen? }` with option kind `allow_once`, `allow_always`, `reject_once` or `reject_always`, and `chosen` the option the person picked.

done.description: False while it is still coming or still running; for a `permission`, while it waits for its answer.

waiting.description: The agent asked for a permission that has no answer yet.
